title: Plain Link
description: A button with no button about it — label only, no fill, no border, no padding. For the places live draws a stacked list of plain links that a block theme can only build as buttons, because the URL has to come from a block binding and only core/button exposes a bindable `url`. The homepage team card's hover panel is the case it was written for: three white links over a scrim, turning accent on hover, measured from `.lsx-to-single-link a` (sd-lsx-child/assets/css/partials/_cta.scss:466). Inherits nothing from the button element it can avoid — the element's padding, border radius and uppercase transform are all reset here, deliberately, so the variation reads as body text and not as a de-chromed button.
